messages:
incident-bot: PAGE - Service: inference-api - Elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate (region=eu-west-1). Error rate > 12% for 1m, P95 latency 2.4s. Paging oncall@sre

sophie_oncall: on it. seeing console alerts + a spike in 502/504. beginning triage. any recent deploys?

elaine_support: customers reporting timeouts in EU. support queue getting repeats, some pay customers affected (~8 customers opened tickets).

raj_runtime: checking control plane: there was an envoy routing change rolled out 20m ago to change route weights + retry policy for /v1/* (ops/pr-5142).

matt_sre: echoing that. CPU on backend pool inference-replicas-eu is normal but upstreams returning 502s. suspect retry amplification or misapplied circuit-breaker.

sophie_oncall: logs from edge: ```[2026-03-15T10:12:03Z] \"POST /v1/generate\" 502 0.234ms upstream_host=10.12.4.22:8080 x-envoy-retries: 3 x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 1200``` lots of `x-envoy-retries: 3` in header.

raj_runtime: that matches PR note — increased retries from 1->3 to reduce tail latency. problem: backends are overloaded, retries are causing cascade and 502. also circuit-breaker max_connections got lowered in same rollout.

matt_sre: mitigation plan: 1) revert retry policy to 1, 2) revert the circuit-breaker change, 3) scale inference pool + temporarily disable route-weight change. who can roll back config quickly?

sophie_oncall: i can rollback the envoy config to stable-2026-03-15-09:50. running: `deploy-bot revert-config --env=prod --region=eu-west-1 --config=stable-2026-03-15-09:50`

deploy-bot: Accepting request: revert-config job queued (#8420). ETA ~30s to apply to control plane, propagate to proxies ~75s.

elaine_support: heads-up to customers: posting a proactive note to affected tickets and updating status page with \"partial errors in EU for inference API\".

sophie_oncall: revert applied. checking metrics...

(30s later)

incident-bot: CONTROL_PLANE_EVENT config-revert-complete config=stable-2026-03-15-09:50 region=eu-west-1 job=8420

sophie_oncall: saw error rate drop from 12% -> 2.8% over past 2m. p95 latency down to 800ms. still seeing occasional 502s from a subset of pods.

raj_runtime: rolling circuit-breaker to previous thresholds and disabling aggressive retries for the route. command: ```kubectl apply -f /configs/envoy/cb-defaults.yaml --context=prod-eu```

matt_sre: scaling inference pool by +20% for eu-west-1 to absorb in-flight retries: `kscale inference-replicas-eu 1.2`

raj_runtime: applied cb revert. metric shows connections error budget regained.

sophie_oncall: monitoring for 10m to confirm stability. creating a temporary routing rule to route 20% of traffic to a secondary pool with fewer quantized models to reduce backend processing time.

elaine_support: notified customers that mitigation is in progress and ETA 15-30m for full recovery. adding triage note: \"possible misconfiguration in recent envoy rollout; rollback performed; scaling and cb tweaks in progress.\"

matt_sre: suggest immediate postmortem: owners: raj_runtime (root cause), sophie_oncall (mitigation), deploy team (PR author). action items: add gating for retry increases, add synthetic tests that simulate backend overload, add a rollout checklist to prevent simultaneous cb+retry changes.

raj_runtime: quick note: there's a config lint that should have flagged low cb thresholds vs. retry count when combined. i'll add a check to CI.

sophie_oncall: error rate now stable at 1.2% for last 3m. p95 420ms. closing page in 10m if stable.

incident-bot: PAGE_RESOLVE - Service: inference-api - Incident marked as mitigated by sophie_oncall. Duration so far: 00:18:26.

elaine_support: will follow up with affected customers and include mitigation summary + timeline.

matt_sre: filing incident ticket and scheduling postmortem sync for tomorrow 11:00 UTC. tagging owners.

sophie_oncall: final note: do not roll retry policy and circuit-breaker thresholds in same PR. also add a short runbook step: if 5xx spike + many x-envoy-retries headers, immediately reduce retries and scale backends.

raj_runtime: agreed. adding CB/retry cross-check to PR template now.

(threads/attachments: links to metric dashboard, PR 5142 diff, rollback job 8420 logs)
